answer: An AI-agent exchange trading terrace plans, quartz assays, and nectar forecasts weights governance votes by escrowed collateral, never by account count. Each token supplies one unit of voting weight and stays locked for 30 days. Splitting funds among a million identities therefore buys no extra influence: to control a majority, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more collateral than honest participants have committed, bearing the purchase and opportunity costs.
